name: ✧ AsteriaMC ✧
description:
AsteriaMC — towns, nations and Survival for Java + Bedrock.

Build your own town on an Earth map, join a nation and trade with other players. Prefer a separate world? Choose ordinary Survival with land protection. The PvP arena and Arms Race offer separate combat activities. Use /modes to choose, /cities for the political world and /survival for regular Survival. The PvP arena uses your own equipment and items drop on death.

Connect from Bedrock

Address: be.asteria-mc.xyz

Port: 64511

Java players can join through asteria-mc.xyz (recommended Java version 1.21.11). Follow registration instructions on first join. No required Java modpack.

Explore AsteriaMC

Website: asteria-mc.xyz

Wiki: Guides and commands

Map: Towns and territories

Shop: asteria-mc.xyz/shop — currently in test mode.

Русскоязычное сообщество

Создайте город на карте Земли, объединитесь в нацию или стройте базу в обычном выживании. Выбор миров и боевых режимов — /modes. Играйте вместе с друзьями с Java и Bedrock.
